title: Do Tool Calls Execute as Intended? Measuring and Repairing Intent-Execution Correspondence in LLM Agents
title_zh: 工具调用是否按预期执行？衡量与修复 LLM 智能体中意图与执行的一致性

paragraphs.en: Agents built on large language models (LLMs) build and run software through tool calls. A call reaches its program through several hops, and any hop can change the call without notice. When the changed call fails, the agent retries a correct call, which costs users time and money. Benchmarks and failure analyses do not see the change, because they read the call and its result but not what a hop received. We define intent-execution correspondence (IEC) as the property that the executed action matches the action the emitted call denotes under the tool contract. Our protocol observes what each hop received without executing the call, and names the first hop that changed it by the receiver’s own parser. IntAct then delivers the call in a form that this hop cannot alter, or refuses the call. We build IEC-Bench from the changes observed in real-world use, with chains of dependent calls under the execution paths of 4 widely-used harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过工具调用来构建和运行软件。 一次调用需要经过多次跳转才能到达其程序，而任何一次跳转都可能在不通知的情况下修改该调用。 当被修改的调用失败时，智能体会重试正确的调用，这会耗费用户的时间和金钱。 基准测试和故障分析无法发现这种修改，因为它们只读取调用及其结果，而不查看某次跳转实际接收到的内容。 我们将意图-执行对应性（IEC）定义为：在工具契约的约束下，所执行的动作与所发出调用表示的动作相匹配的特性。 我们的协议会观察每次跳转接收到的内容，而不会执行该调用，并通过接收方自身的解析器确定第一个修改该调用的跳转。 IntAct 随后将以该跳转无法更改的形式传递调用，或者直接拒绝该调用。 我们从真实使用场景中观察到的修改中构建 IEC-Bench，其中包含了 4 种广泛使用的测试框架执行路径下的依赖调用链。

paragraphs.en: In 47,828 shell calls within production sessions, Claude Code’s Bash tool changes 12.0% of the calls that carry code, escape sequences, or long text. For 80.7% of the calls whose backslashes are changed, the wrong action runs without any reported error. All 10 measured harnesses change a call. Trajectory-based judgment attributes 95.1% of the production failures to the LLM, although the path caused more than half of them. On IEC-Bench , the path raises the token cost per passed task 2.4 times (up to 12.3 times). A hop that changes a call also hides the changes after it, so 55.1% of the failures on one path appear only after its first hop is repaired. IntAct , deployed in a commercial product, recovers 79.2% of the failures with a changed call. Harnesses should therefore be designed and tested hop-by-hop to ensure a correct call executes as intended or is refused.
paragraphs.zh: 在生产会话中，Claude Code 的 Bash 工具在 47,828 次 shell 调用中修改了 12.0% 包含代码、转义序列或长文本的调用。 对于 80.7% 被修改反斜杠的调用，错误的操作会直接执行，而没有任何错误提示。 所有 10 个经过测量的测试框架都修改了至少一次调用。 基于轨迹的判断将 95.1% 的生产故障归因于 LLM，尽管实际路径导致了其中超过一半的故障。 在 IEC-Bench 上，该路径使每项通过任务的令牌成本增加了 2.4 倍（最高可达 12.3 倍）。 修改调用的步骤还会隐藏其后续的变化，因此某条路径上 55.1% 的故障只有在修复了第一步之后才会显现。 部署在商业产品中的 IntAct 能够恢复 79.2% 因调用被修改而导致的故障。 因此，测试框架应按步骤逐一设计和测试，以确保正确的调用能按预期执行或被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Agents built on large language models (LLMs) build and run software through tool calls [ 54 , 27 ] . A tool call reaches its program over an execution path: the harness serializes the arguments, a host wrapper passes them to an interpreter, the operating system forwards them, and the program parses them again. 1 1 1 https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/microsoft.powershell.core/about/about_parsing Each of these hops can change the call without notice [ 25 ] , as the 2 recorded runs of Figure 1 show. The program then executes an action that the agent did not intend. Problems of command execution account for 25.0% of 3,864 bug reports of 3 coding agents [ 58 ] . They cost users failed runs and retries, and therefore time and money [ 35 , 48 ] . However, benchmarks score the selected call [ 32 , 55 ] or the final state [ 21 ] and assume that the call is executed as written. A failure that the path caused is therefore incorrectly attributed to the LLM, and these scores decide which LLM is adopted and which harness is deployed [ 50 ] . Failure analyses do not correct the attribution, because the trajectory records the call and its result but not what a hop received [ 59 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过工具调用构建和运行软件 [ 54 , 27 ] 。 工具调用通过一条执行路径到达其程序：执行框架将参数序列化，主机包装器将其传递给解释器，操作系统将其转发，程序再次解析这些参数。1 1 1 https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/microsoft.powershell.core/about/about_parsing 这些步骤中的任何一个都可能在不通知的情况下改变调用 [ 25 ] ，如图 1 中记录的两次运行所示。 随后，程序执行了智能体并未预期的操作。 命令执行问题占 3 个编码智能体所报告的 3,864 个错误中的 25.0% [ 58 ] 。 这些问题导致用户出现运行失败和重试，从而造成时间和金钱的损失 [ 35 , 48 ] 。 然而，基准测试评估的是所选的调用 [ 32 , 55 ] 或最终状态 [ 21 ]，并假设调用是按原样执行的。 因此，由执行路径引起的故障被错误地归因于 LLM，而这些评分决定了采用哪个 LLM 以及部署哪个执行框架 [ 50 ] 。 故障分析并未纠正这种归因，因为轨迹记录了调用及其结果，但并未记录某个步骤接收到的内容 [ 59 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Existing research on agent reliability mostly examines what the LLM did. Who&When [ 59 ] names the responsible agent and step from the trajectory. Empirical studies classify failures from trajectories [ 28 , 30 , 7 ] . Other techniques act on the agent rather than on the path. Fault injection tests an agent system [ 41 , 20 , 37 ] . Causal Agent Replay [ 38 ] re-executes a run from one of its steps. Reflexion [ 39 ] lets the agent retry. ToolBench-X [ 42 ] injects visible tool-environment hazards, and Gupta et al. [ 15 ] return structured execution feedback. Further studies examine defects between LLM and harness [ 10 , 31 ] . Only a few studies examine the path itself. QuoteBench [ 25 ] measures the wrapper, and BatBadBut documents batch-file argument passing. 2 2 2 https://flatt.tech/research/posts/batbadbut-you-cant-securely-execute-commands-on-windows/ None of these studies establishes whether the executed action matches the action the emitted call denotes under the tool contract. We call this property intent-execution correspondence (IEC).
paragraphs.zh: 关于智能体可靠性的现有研究主要考察了大型语言模型（LLM）执行了什么操作。 Who&When [ 59 ] 从轨迹中指出了负责的智能体和步骤。 实证研究通过轨迹对故障进行分类 [ 28 , 30 , 7 ] 。 其他技术则针对智能体本身，而非路径进行操作。 故障注入方法用于测试智能体系统 [ 41 , 20 , 37 ] 。 因果智能体重播 [ 38 ] 会从某个步骤重新开始执行一次运行过程。 Reflexion [ 39 ] 允许智能体进行重试。 ToolBench-X [ 42 ] 会注入可见的工具-环境风险，而 Gupta 等人 [ 15 ] 则返回结构化的执行反馈。 进一步的研究考察了大型语言模型（LLM）与执行框架之间的缺陷 [ 10 , 31 ] 。 仅有少数研究考察了路径本身。 QuoteBench [ 25 ] 用于衡量包装器，而 BatBadBut 记录了批处理文件中的参数传递方式。2 2 2 https://flatt.tech/research/posts/batbadbut-you-cant-securely-execute-commands-on-windows/ 这些研究均未明确判断所执行的动作是否与工具合同中该调用所表示的动作一致。 我们将这一特性称为“意图-执行对应性”（IEC）。

[ 58 ] analyze bug reports, so none shows how often and at which hop calls change in real-world use. Causal Agent Replay [ 38 ] , Reflexion [ 39 ] , Gupta et al. [ 15 ] , and QuoteBench’s temporary file act on a step, on the feedback, or on the wrapper alone. Validating an attribution, however, requires repairing that hop alone.

paragraphs.en: To address these gaps, we propose the IEC protocol, which measures the path, and IntAct , which repairs it. A recorded call cannot be executed again safely, so the IEC protocol observes what each hop received without executing the call (①). Different texts can denote the same action, so the receiver’s own parser decides whether the action changed, and the IEC protocol names the first hop that changed it (②). A hop that changes a call hides the changes after it, so the IEC protocol confirms an attribution by re-executing the recorded run with only that hop repaired (③). IntAct then delivers the call in a form that this hop cannot alter, or refuses the call. The hop determines the form, so one technique repairs a path at its wrapper, at the hand-over to the program, or at both.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 IEC 协议，用于测量路径，以及 IntAct，用于修复路径。 已录制的调用无法再次安全执行，因此 IEC 协议会观察每个跳点接收到的内容，而不会执行该调用（①）。 不同的文本可能表示相同的操作，因此接收方自身的解析器会判断操作是否发生变化，而 IEC 协议则会命名第一个导致该变化发生的跳点（②）。 改变调用的跳点会隐藏其后的变化，因此 IEC 协议会通过仅修复该跳点并重新执行已录制的运行流程来确认归因（③）。 随后，IntAct 将以该跳点无法更改的形式传递调用，或者直接拒绝该调用。 跳点决定了形式，因此一种技术是在其包装层、程序交接处或两者同时修复路径。

paragraphs.en: The main contributions of this work are as follows:

paragraphs.en: Problem and finding. We define intent-execution correspondence for tool calls and chains of dependent calls, and find that a hop that changes a call hides the changes after it. On a path with 2 such hops, 38 of the 69 failures that the path caused appear only after the first hop is repaired.
paragraphs.zh: 问题与发现。 我们为工具调用和依赖调用的链定义了意图-执行对应关系，并发现一个改变调用的跳转会隐藏其后的变化。 在一条包含两个此类跳转的路径中，该路径引发的 69 次故障中有 38 次仅在修复第一个跳转后才出现。

paragraphs.en: Measurement of real-world use. The first measurement of changed calls in real-world use covers 47,828 shell calls of 261 production sessions, 9 developers on Linux, 10 harnesses, 6 shells, 22 MCP servers, and 3 public trajectory sources. Claude Code’s Bash tool changes 12.0% of the calls that carry code, escape sequences, or long text. For 80.7% of the calls whose backslashes are changed, the wrong action runs without any reported error.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation method. The IEC protocol observes each hop without executing the call and, by the receiver’s own parser, names the first hop that changed the call. paragraphs.en: Solution and validation. IntAct repairs the path at the hop that the IEC protocol names, composes repairs where an earlier hop hides a later one, and refuses a call that it cannot deliver as written. It recovers 79.2% of the IEC-Bench failures with a changed call and lowers the token cost per passed task 2.4 times. We deploy it in production and in a commercial product, and release it as a Claude Code mod, a shell shim, and an MCP server. We compare the IEC protocol and IntAct with published attribution and repair baselines on 4 LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 解决方案与验证。 IntAct 会在 IEC 协议指定的跳点修复路径，在早期跳点隐藏了后期跳点时组合修复，并拒绝无法按原样交付的调用。 它通过修改调用恢复了 79.2% 的 IEC-Bench 故障，并将每项成功完成任务的令牌成本降低了 2.4 倍。 我们已将其部署到生产环境和一款商业产品中，并以 Claude Code 模块、外壳程序和 MCP 服务器的形式发布。 我们在 4 种 LLM 上，将 IEC 协议和 IntAct 与已发表的归因及修复基线进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: The intended action a a of a tool call is the action the emitted call denotes under the tool contract, that is, the shell or argument semantics that the tool description states to the LLM. We take the emitted call as the intent, not the LLM’s or the user’s goal [ 14 ] , so that a change by the path can be told from a generation error. A call whose text is incorrect for its shell is an incorrect intent executed as written, and its failure is a generation error. For a command, the action is its executable, ordered argument vector, control operators, working directory, task-relevant environment, and standard input. For a structured tool, the action is its bound argument values. A harness is the program that runs the agent, and a launch is the way a harness starts a shell or a program. The call reaches the program over the execution path, a sequence of hops Π = ⟨ b 1 , … , b m ⟩ \Pi=\langle b_{1},\ldots,b_{m}\rangle . At each hop, one side serializes the call and the receiving side parses it. Let r i r_{i} be the action that the receiver of hop b i b_{i} parses, in the working directory and environment of the launch. The path corresponds for a a when every hop receives the intended action, r i = a r_{i}=a for all i i . The first hop that receives a different action is the first divergence , 𝖥𝖣 ⁡ ( a , Π ) = min ⁡ { i ∣ r i ≠ a } \mathsf{FD}(a,\Pi)=\min\{i\mid r_{i}\neq a\} . Section 2.3 states how the receiver’s own parser decides whether r i = a r_{i}=a . A divergence is silent when the tool result returned to the agent contains neither an error flag nor a parser or quoting error message, and loud otherwise.
paragraphs.zh: 工具调用的预期动作 a 是指该调用在工具合同中表示的动作，即工具描述向 LLM 说明的 shell 或参数语义。 我们将已发出的调用视为意图，而非 LLM 或用户的目标 [14]，这样路径中的变化才能与生成错误区分开来。 若调用的文本与其 shell 不匹配，则属于错误的意图按原样执行，其失败即为生成错误。 对于命令而言，动作包括其可执行文件、有序参数向量、控制操作符、工作目录、任务相关的环境以及标准输入。 对于结构化工具而言，动作即其绑定的参数值。 运行器是运行智能体的程序，而启动则是运行器启动 shell 或程序的方式。 该调用通过执行路径到达程序，该路径是一系列跳转序列 Π = ⟨ b 1 , … , b m ⟩ \Pi=\langle b_{1},\ldots,b_{m}\rangle 。 在每个跳转处，一方将调用序列化，而接收方则对其进行解析。 令 r i r_{i} 为跳转 b i b_{i} 的接收方在工作目录和启动环境中解析出的动作。 当所有跳转都接收到预期动作时，即对于所有 i，r i = a r_{i}=a，则路径与 a 对应。 第一个接收到不同动作的跳转即为首次分歧，𝖥𝖣 ⁡ ( a , Π ) = min ⁡ { i ∣ r i ≠ a } \mathsf{FD}(a,\Pi)=\min\{i\mid r_{i}\neq a\} 。 第 2.3 节说明了接收方自身的解析器如何判断 r i = a r_{i}=a 。 当返回给智能体的工具结果既不包含错误标志，也不包含解析器或引号错误信息时，分歧是静默的；否则则为显性的。

paragraphs.en: A hop changes a call through 4 mechanisms. In quote consumption , text appended to a command line is parsed a second time, so (gy console.log("test") arrives as (gy console.log(test) . In re-expansion , a receiver reinterprets a delivered literal, (gy %PATH% in a batch operand or (gy !x in an interactive Bash. In truncation , the MSYS2 runtime of Git Bash cuts a quoted argument at 8,186 UTF-16 code units 3 3 3 https://github.com/zetaloop/msys2-argv-fix and collapses its backslash pairs 4 4 4 https://github.com/msys2/msys2-runtime/issues/36 , and (gy cmd.exe ends a command at its first line break. In an arity change , an operand is dropped or split. Neither stdout, stderr, nor the exit code names the mechanism. The same mechanism is repaired differently at different hops, so the hop determines the repair.
paragraphs.zh: 一次跳转会通过 4 种机制改变一个调用。 在引号消耗中，附加到命令行的文本会被第二次解析，因此 (gy console.log("test") 会变成 (gy console.log(test)。 在重新展开中，接收器会重新解释一个已交付的字面量，例如批处理操作符中的 (gy %PATH% 或交互式 Bash 中的 (gy !x。 在截断中，Git Bash 的 MSYS2 运行时会将带引号的参数在 8,186 个 UTF-16 编码单元处截断 3 3 3 https://github.com/zetaloop/msys2-argv-fix，并合并其反斜杠对 4 4 4 https://github.com/msys2/msys2-runtime/issues/36，而 (gy cmd.exe 则会在命令的第一行换行处结束该命令。 在元数变化中，一个操作符会被丢弃或拆分。 既不是 stdout、stderr，也不是退出代码能够命名这种机制。 同一种机制在不同跳转中会以不同方式修复，因此跳转决定了修复方式。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 presents IntAct and the IEC protocol. The path of a command has 5 hops: the tool serialization, the host wrapper, the shell parse, the process interface, and the target parser. IntAct takes each call before the host wrapper and refuses a call that it cannot deliver as written. Otherwise, it applies the rendering of each hop that the IEC protocol names, a form of the call that this hop cannot alter, and passes the rendered text into the launch. In the IEC protocol, witnesses report what each hop received without executing the call (A, Section 2.2 ). The receiver’s own parser names the first divergence (B, Section 2.3 ). The repair replay , the replay of a recorded run with only that hop repaired, confirms the losses that the path caused (C, Section 4.4 ). For this replay, we record calls and tool results as emitted and received, and a reply cache replays a run without an LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 展示了 IntAct 和 IEC 协议。 一条命令的路径包含 5 个跳转：工具序列化、主机包装器、外壳解析、进程接口和目标解析器。 IntAct 会处理主机包装器之前的每次调用，并拒绝任何无法按原样传递的调用。 否则，它会应用 IEC 协议所命名的每个跳转的渲染形式——即该跳转无法更改的调用形式——并将渲染后的文本传入启动过程。 在 IEC 协议中，见证者会报告每个跳转接收到的内容，但不会执行调用（A，第 2.2 节）。 接收方自身的解析器会指出第一个分歧点（B，第 2.3 节）。 修复重播——即仅修复该跳转后对已记录运行流程的重播——可以确认路径造成的数据丢失情况（C，第 4.4 节）。 在此重播中，我们会记录所发出和接收的调用与工具结果，而回复缓存则会在没有 LLM 的情况下重播一次运行流程。

paragraphs.en: A witness reports what a hop received and executes nothing. Executing a recorded call again is neither safe nor repeatable, and the trajectory holds only the text that the agent sent and the result that came back. A witness therefore keeps the harness’s launch and replaces only the program that would execute the command with one that reports the received text. For Bash, the witness is the file named by (gy BASH_ENV , which Bash sources before it executes the command string, so the reported string has passed through the wrapper as in the harness. For a launch that appends the command after (gy -Command , the appended launch , the witness computes the script that PowerShell executes by the rules that (gy powershell.exe applies to its command line. The call changes at the wrapper when PowerShell’s parse of this script differs from its parse of the text. A one-argument launch passes the text to (gy powershell.exe as one argument, which the wrapper delivers intact. At the process interface, the witness records the argument vector that a native program receives, which the script does not show. The witness parses the script without execution and runs each native invocation with constant arguments separately, with an argv probe in place of the program. With an LLM in the loop, an argv sentry in place of the target program also records the ancestor processes, which gives the wrapper of a running harness. For structured tools, the witness records the bound values that the tool function receives.

paragraphs.en: The IEC protocol decides whether a hop changed a call by the receiver’s own parser, not by string equality or judgment. Texts that differ can denote the same action, as (gy "a\\b" and (gy "a\b" denote the same word in Bash, and string comparison classifies 15 of 35 unchanged pairs as changed (Section 4.3 ). The IEC protocol compares the operators, words, and heredoc bodies of a Bash command, the parse tree of a PowerShell script, and the argument vector of a program. The comparisons return a verdict for 99.98% of the 32,259 Bash calls of the production sessions.
paragraphs.zh: IEC 协议通过接收方自身的解析器判断某个跳转是否改变了调用，而非依赖字符串相等性或人工判断。 不同的文本可能表示相同的操作，例如 (gy "a\\b" 和 (gy "a\b" 在 Bash 中表示同一个词，而字符串比较将 35 对未改变文本中的 15 对误判为已改变（第 4.3 节）。 IEC 协议会对比 Bash 命令的操作符、单词和 heredoc 主体、PowerShell 脚本的解析树，以及程序的参数向量。 这些比较对生产会话中 32,259 个 Bash 调用的 99.98% 返回了判定结果。

paragraphs.en: The IEC protocol attributes a loud failure to generation, to the path, or to a nested hop. The error message does not tell them apart, because it refers to the agent’s text in every case. The IEC protocol first parses the agent’s text with execution disabled, by the interpreter that receives it. Text that does not parse was incorrect when emitted, a generation error. Text that parses is delivered again through the witness, and a difference is attributed to the path. An error at a line beyond the end of the agent’s text is also attributed to the path, because that line lies in the text that the wrapper appends. Text that parses, is received intact, and invokes a further interpreter fails at a nested hop.
paragraphs.zh: IEC 协议将严重故障归因于生成、路径或嵌套跳点。 错误信息无法区分这些情况，因为它在所有情况下都引用了智能体的文本。 IEC 协议首先由接收该文本的解释器，在禁用执行的情况下解析智能体的文本。 无法解析的文本在发出时即不正确，属于生成错误。 能够解析的文本会通过见证再次传递，其差异则归因于路径。 位于智能体文本末尾之后的某一行出现的错误也归因于路径，因为该行属于包装程序附加的文本部分。 能够解析的文本被完整接收，但在调用进一步解释器时于嵌套跳点处失败。

The C runtime of the program parses native ⁡ ( s ) \mathrm{native}(s) back to s s . For example, (gy print("hi") becomes (gy print(\"hi\") (Figure 2 ). A launch that changes calls at 2 hops receives both renderings, that of the later hop first. On the appended launch, the script is rendered for the process interface and then encoded for the wrapper, which consumes the quotes first. IntAct refuses a call that no rendering carries, and names the hop. Executing such a call would run a different action without notice, so the refusal is the only outcome that keeps the correspondence. paragraphs.en: The Windows corpus contains 47,828 shell calls that Claude Code and Codex ran through Git Bash and Windows PowerShell 5.1 in 261 sessions by 6 developers from a company over 11 weeks. A resumed conversation copies its earlier calls into the new transcript, and we count each call once. We exclude the project of this study. We study the exposed calls of the corpus, which we select by their text before execution. A Bash call is exposed when it carries a heredoc, a backslash pair, or at least 1,000 characters. paragraphs.en: IEC-Bench has 67 pattern pairs, 10 multi-line programs, 135 ToolHop chains, and 46 tasks of Terminal-Bench 2. Each hazard class of IEC-Bench is a change observed in the recorded sessions and runs, which we write with new literals and data so that no session text is released. A pattern pair is a hazard variant and a control variant of a task that require the same tool calls and differ in one literal and the input data built from it. The literal triggers the change only in the hazard variant. The pair is lost when the control variant passes and the hazard variant fails. An agent runs the pattern pairs with a shell tool alone, shell only , or with a file-write tool in addition. The 135 chains, of 3 to 7 steps, are up to 30 per step count drawn from the 990 ToolHop queries that pass a value requiring quoting, plus 5 that pass none. We pair each Terminal-Bench task across a Linux and a Windows container with unchanged instruction, inputs, and verifier, and keep it only if the reference solution passes on both. The oracles check the state that a task leaves against expected values computed without a shell. IEC-Bench runs under 6 transports , its execution paths. 2 are references: direct JSON arguments, and Git Bash with the command in a file, the control. 2 reproduce Claude Code’s Bash tool and Qwen Code’s (gy cmd.exe
paragraphs.zh: IEC-Bench 包含 67 对模式、10 个多行程序、135 条 ToolHop 链以及 46 项 Terminal-Bench 2 任务。 IEC-Bench 的每个风险类别都是记录会话和运行过程中观察到的变化，我们通过新的字面量和数据来编写这些变化，以确保不泄露任何会话文本。 一对模式包括一个任务的风险变体和一个控制变体，它们需要相同的工具调用，但仅在一个字面量和由此构建的输入数据上存在差异。 该字面量仅在风险变体中触发变化。 当控制变体通过而风险变体失败时，这对模式即被视为失效。 智能体单独使用 shell 工具、仅使用 shell，或额外配合文件写入工具来运行这些模式对。 这 135 条链包含 3 到 7 个步骤，每个步骤数量的链最多有 30 条，它们从 990 个 ToolHop 查询中选取，这些查询传递了需要引号的值，另有 5 个未传递任何值。 我们将每个 Terminal-Bench 任务与一个 Linux 容器和一个 Windows 容器进行配对，保持指令、输入和验证器不变，并且仅当参考解决方案在两个容器中均通过时保留该任务。 预言机通过检查任务留下的状态与无需 shell 即可计算出的预期值来验证结果。 IEC-Bench 在 6 种传输方式（即执行路径）下运行。其中 2 种是参考方式：直接传递 JSON 参数，以及将命令置于文件中的 Git Bash（即控制方式）。另外 2 种分别复现了 Claude Code 的 Bash 工具和 Qwen Code 的（gy cmd.exe）工具。

sents.en: A pattern pair is a hazard variant and a control variant of a task that require the same tool calls and differ in one literal and the input data built from it.

sents.en: The literal triggers the change only in the hazard variant.
sents.zh: 该字面量仅在风险变体中触发变化。

sents.en: The pair is lost when the control variant passes and the hazard variant fails.
sents.zh: 当控制变体通过而风险变体失败时，这对模式即被视为失效。

paragraphs.en: For attribution, we compare the IEC protocol with 3 LLM judges, 2 replay techniques, and 4 ablations. The judges are those of Who&When [ 59 ] : all-at-once, step-by-step, and binary search. They run with their released prompts and settings on Qwen2.5-72B, an LLM from the original evaluation, without ground truth, up to the failed call. We map a verdict that names the assistant to generation, and one that names a tool to the path. The 2 replay techniques run on the lost pairs of IEC-Bench . Causal Agent Replay [ 38 ] resamples the run at each agent step with 8 rollouts, and QuoteBench’s fixed-reply replay [ 25 ] sends the recorded actions through a temporary file. The QuoteBench reference is the repair replay on the 324 lost pairs that this replay attributes, the 137 recovered pairs, and the 187 without a changed call in Section 4.4 . The reference of Causal Agent Replay is the witness on the shell-only losses. 4 ablations each remove one component of the IEC protocol: no attribution, no receiver parse, no witness, and an LLM judge in place of the witness and the receiver parse, run with 2 LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 在归因分析中，我们将 IEC 协议与 3 个 LLM 智能体、2 种重播技术和 4 种消融实验进行了比较。 这些智能体来自 Who&When [59]：包括“一次性处理”、“分步处理”和“二分搜索”。 它们在 Qwen2.5-72B（原始评估中使用的 LLM）上运行，使用其已发布的提示词和设置，没有地面真值，直至调用失败为止。 我们将指出助手名称的判定结果映射到生成过程，而指出工具名称的判定结果则映射到路径。 这 2 种重播技术在 IEC-Bench 中失败的配对上运行。 Causal Agent Replay [38] 在每个智能体步骤处通过 8 次展开重新采样运行过程，而 QuoteBench 的固定回复重播 [25] 则通过临时文件发送记录的动作。 QuoteBench 的参考数据包括：该重播方法归因于失败的 324 个配对、恢复的 137 个配对，以及第 4.4 节中调用未发生变化的 187 个配对的修复重播结果。 Causal Agent Replay 的参考数据是仅涉及外壳操作失败时的见证结果。4 种消融实验分别移除了 IEC 协议的一个组件：无归因、无接收方解析、无见证，以及用 LLM 智能体替代见证和接收方解析（并使用 2 个 LLM 运行）。

paragraphs.en: For repair, we compare IntAct on the same items with 4 published interventions and 3 ablations. 2 come from QuoteBench [ 25 ] : the temporary file and the disclosed-boundary contract, a description of the transport’s path in place of the sentence that names the shell. The third is the structured execution feedback of Gupta et al. [ 15 ] , with command, status, exit code, output, and error in the tool result. The fourth is Reflexion [ 39 ] , which reflects on a failed trial and retries, using the task oracle as the evaluator. The ablations are each of IntAct ’s 2 repairs alone on the appended launch, and an evidence ablation that reports the call as sent and as received, with the named hop, in the tool result.
paragraphs.zh: 在修复方面，我们将 IntAct 在同一项目上与 4 项已发表的干预措施和 3 项消融实验进行比较。其中 2 项来自 QuoteBench [ 25 ]：临时文件和披露边界的合同，该合同用对运输路径的描述替代了命名外壳的句子。 第三项是 Gupta 等人提出的结构化执行反馈。 [ 15 ]，包含工具结果中的命令、状态、退出代码、输出和错误。 第四项是 Reflexion [ 39 ]，它会对失败的尝试进行反思并重新尝试，使用任务预言机作为评估器。 消融实验包括单独对附加启动执行 IntAct 的 2 种修复，以及一种证据消融实验，该实验在工具结果中报告调用被发送和接收的情况，并包含命名的跳转步骤。

paragraphs.en: Pass@k (Table 7 ). An item is a hazard or control variant of a pattern pair, judged by its oracle, or a chain, judged by its answer. A cell reports pass@ k k , the number of its items that pass within k k trials. Every cell is pass@1, 1 trial at temperature 0, except the 2 columns with 10 trials of Table 7 . A pair allows 10 steps and 120 s per command, and a chain 15 steps and 60 s. paragraphs.en: [Objective and Design]: To measure how often, and at which hop, a call is executed as a different action, we replay each recorded call through the witness of its hop. The replay uses the shortest wrapper that the harness generates, and we compare the received action with the sent one (Sections 2.2 and 2.3 ). In the last 3 weeks of the Windows corpus, IntAct delivers the Bash commands as files. On Linux, the corpora and 99 shell blocks of the anthropics/skills repository 7 7 7 https://github.com/anthropics/skills pass through the released command handling of OpenHands, Gemini CLI, Aider, and SWE-ReX, Terminus-2’s tmux typing, and dash and zsh. The harnesses and 18 MCP servers that execute commands receive 20 payloads under an argv sentry. The payloads are argument values with quotes, backslashes, line breaks, and other special characters. Each harness runs in its default configuration on Windows 11 with Windows PowerShell 5.1 and Git for Windows. 4 structured MCP servers receive the payloads as JSON arguments, and we compare what the backend stores with the contract of each tool.
paragraphs.zh: [目标与设计]：为了衡量调用作为不同动作被执行时的频率以及发生的具体跳转步骤，我们会通过其跳转步骤的见证者重新播放每个已记录的调用。 重新播放过程使用测试框架生成的最短包装器，并将接收到的动作与发送的动作进行比较（第 2.2 节和第 2.3 节）。 在 Windows 语料库的最后 3 周中，IntAct 以文件形式提供 Bash 命令。 在 Linux 系统中，anthropics/skills 存储库的语料库和 99 个 shell 块（7 7 7 https://github.com/anthropics/skills）会经过 OpenHands、Gemini CLI、Aider 和 SWE-ReX 发布的命令处理机制，以及 Terminus-2 的 tmux 输入和 dash 与 zsh。 执行命令的测试框架和 18 个 MCP 服务器会在一个 argv 哨兵下接收 20 个负载。 这些负载是包含引号、反斜杠、换行符和其他特殊字符的参数值。 每个测试框架都在 Windows 11 系统上以默认配置运行，使用 Windows PowerShell 5.1 和适用于 Windows 的 Git。4 个结构化 MCP 服务器将负载作为 JSON 参数接收，我们会比较后端存储的内容与每个工具的契约。

paragraphs.en: [Experimental Results]: In the replay, 1,199 of the 11,982 exposed calls change, a changed-call rate of 10.0% (Table 2 ). Through Claude Code’s Bash launch, 12.0% of the 7,491 exposed Bash calls change. The rate is 67.0% for a call with a backslash pair and 100% for a call of at least 8,000 characters (Figure 3(a) ). The wrapper changes a Bash call in 2 ways. It merges backslash pairs, and the wrong action runs without any reported error for 535 of the 663 such calls that ran before IntAct , so 80.7% of these changes are silent (Figure 3(b) ). It also cuts the command, and all 11 cut calls that ran before IntAct fail with an error. IntAct rerouted 227 of the changed calls, and 1 was rejected at Claude Code’s approval prompt before it ran. A changed call occurs in 65 of the 199 sessions with an exposed call, a share of 32.7%. On the Bash tool, 30 of the 39 sessions with an exposed call contain one, and 23 of the 27 sessions with at least 100 Bash calls.

paragraphs.en: A changed call that fails loudly misleads the agent about the cause. Of the 47,828 shell calls, 709 contain a parser or quoting error message, 426 of them a Bash or Python parse error. Of these 426, the IEC protocol attributes 306 to the path, 84 to generation, and 36 to a nested hop (Figure 3(c) ). The 306 are 253 cut commands, 46 merged backslash pairs, and 7 quotes left open at the wrapper. Each of the 306 was reported to the agent as an error in its own text. In 231 of the 306, the shortest wrapper delivers the call as written and only the longer wrapper of its session changed it, so the replay’s changed-call rate is a lower bound.
paragraphs.zh: 一个被修改且明显出错的调用会误导智能体，使其误判错误原因。 在 47,828 个 shell 调用中，有 709 个包含解析器或引号相关的错误信息，其中 426 个是 Bash 或 Python 的解析错误。 在这 426 个错误中，IEC 协议将 306 个归因于路径问题，84 个归因于生成问题，36 个则归因于嵌套跳转（图 3(c)）。 这 306 个错误包括 253 个 cut 命令、46 对被合并的反斜杠对，以及 7 个在包装器中未正确闭合的引号。 这 306 个错误中的每一个都在其自身文本中被报告为错误并反馈给智能体。 在这 306 个错误中的 231 个里，最短的包装器保留了原始调用的写法，只有该会话中较长的包装器对其进行了修改，因此重播中的修改调用率是一个下限值。

paragraphs.en: [Objective and Design]: The first divergence should name a fault injected at a known hop, and IntAct , which repairs only the named hop, should recover the losses that the path caused. First, we test the localization by fault injection on Windows. We start from a base path that delivers all 24 payloads unchanged, and inject one of 7 known faults at a time, each at one of the 5 hops. The 24 payloads are the 20 base payloads and 4 further cases, a long string, a variable expression, trailing spaces, and quotes with a space, which gives 168 injections. Second, we render the modified Linux batches and commands (Table 3 ) with IntAct and pass them through the harness’s release handling and the Bash witness. We also type 30 further pattern pairs, the typed pairs, into an interactive Bash as Terminus-2 does. Their literal contains a (gy ! inside double quotes. Third, on IEC-Bench , we replay the recorded writes and commands of a run in a fresh sandbox through the transport with the named hop repaired. Where a launch changes calls at 2 hops, we repair both, and the oracle grades the final state. This replay covers the 360 lost pairs whose failure the original transport reproduces: 173 with a changed call on the 3 launches that have a rendering, and 187 without. Fourth, we evaluate the repairs with the agent in the loop.

paragraphs.en: [Experimental Results]: Of 168 injections, 30 change what the target receives, and the first divergence names the hop in all 30 and in none of the other 138. paragraphs.en: Agents complete tasks through tool calls when they develop software [ 53 , 46 , 45 , 61 , 8 , 6 , 52 , 51 ] , operate applications [ 43 , 24 ] , or use MCP servers [ 17 , 16 ] . Benchmarks of tool use score the selected call [ 32 , 55 , 5 , 56 ] or the state that an agent produces [ 43 , 4 , 21 , 57 , 29 , 47 , 24 , 11 , 33 ] , and ToolBench-X [ 42 ] injects tool-environment hazards visible to the agent. When a run fails, Who&When [ 59 ] attributes the failure to an agent and a step, with an LLM judge that reads the failure log. Causal Agent Replay [ 38 ] re-executes a recorded run from a step and intervenes on that step. Further studies cover failure taxonomies [ 28 , 30 , 7 , 2 ] , LLM-harness defects [ 10 , 31 ] , injected faults [ 41 , 37 , 20 ] , record and replay [ 13 , 9 ] , run instability [ 23 ] , and the launches and engineering of widely-used harnesses [ 3 , 26 , 19 ] . Gupta et al. [ 15 ] identify an intent-execution gap and return structured execution feedback to the agent. Qu et al. [ 34 ] argue for an integrity property from the user’s intent to the execution. Self-correction techniques such as Reflexion [ 39 ] depend on the feedback the agent receives [ 18 , 22 , 12 ] .

QuoteBench [ 25 ] , the closest study, records 1 hop, the wrapper, on 56 tasks against a single reference path. This path bypasses 1 hop, goes through the others, and detects 37.2% of the path-caused losses of IEC-Bench .

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present the IEC protocol, which observes a call without executing it and names the first hop that changed it, and IntAct , which repairs the path at that hop. In 47,828 shell calls within production sessions, Claude Code’s Bash tool changes 12.0% of the calls that carry code, escape sequences, or long text. For 80.7% of the calls whose backslashes are changed, the wrong action runs without any reported error. All 10 measured harnesses change a call. Trajectory-based judgment attributes 95.1% of the production failures to the LLM, although the path caused more than half of them, whereas the IEC protocol agrees with human labels at κ \kappa 0.77. On IEC-Bench , the path raises the token cost per passed task 2.4 times (up to 12.3 times). A hop that changes a call also hides the changes after it, and IntAct recovers 79.2% of the failures with a changed call. These results show that a changed call comes from the launch, not the LLM. A tool-call failure has to be analyzed and repaired across the hops of its path, and the harness establishes intent-execution correspondence independently of the LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 IEC 协议：该协议会观察一个调用而不执行它，并命名第一个改变该调用的跳转点；同时提出了 IntAct，用于修复该跳转点处的路径。 在生产会话中的 47,828 个 shell 调用中，Claude Code 的 Bash 工具改变了其中 12.0% 包含代码、转义序列或长文本的调用。 对于 80.7% 被改变反斜杠的调用，错误的操作会直接执行，而没有任何错误报告。 所有 10 个经过测量的测试框架都会改变一个调用。 基于轨迹的判断将 95.1% 的生产失败归因于 LLM，尽管路径本身导致了其中超过一半的失败；而 IEC 协议与人类标签的一致性为 κ \kappa 0.77。 在 IEC-Bench 上，该路径使每项通过任务的令牌成本增加了 2.4 倍（最高可达 12.3 倍）。 改变一个调用的跳转点也会隐藏其后的所有变化，而 IntAct 能够恢复 79.2% 因调用被改变而导致的失败。 这些结果表明，被改变的调用源于启动过程，而非 LLM。 工具调用失败必须沿着其路径的各个跳转点进行分析与修复，而测试框架则独立于 LLM 建立意图与执行之间的对应关系。

paragraphs.en: Future harnesses should therefore be designed and tested hop-by-hop, so that a correct call is executed as intended or refused, and benchmarks should report their launch and hold it fixed when comparing LLMs. The IEC protocol applies at every hop whose receiver has a parser, so the same measurement covers structured tools and MCP servers, and IEC-Bench grows with each change observed in use. A repair that rewrites a call must leave the harness’s permission rules judging the original call, as the mod does. A benchmark that reports its launch and holds it fixed makes LLM scores comparable across harnesses. We plan to extend the measurement to harnesses that type into a terminal and to launches that appear after this study.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，未来的测试框架应逐跳设计和测试，以确保调用按预期正确执行或被拒绝，并且基准测试在比较大型语言模型时，应报告其启动状态并保持该状态不变。 IEC 协议适用于每个接收端带有解析器的跳点，因此相同的测量范围涵盖了结构化工具和 MCP 服务器，并且随着使用中发现的每次变化，IEC-Bench 也会随之扩展。 任何重写调用的修复操作都必须让测试框架的权限规则继续对原始调用进行判断，就像模块本身所做的那样。 报告其启动状态并保持该状态不变的基准测试，能使不同测试框架下的大型语言模型得分具有可比性。 我们计划将测量范围扩展到那些在终端中输入命令的测试框架，以及在本研究之后出现的启动方式。
